init.title: Bridge polling
init.description: Shared mode and interval for dials and buttons. Active mode starts temporary reads after the first event. Continuous mode also reads while idle. Dials and buttons use two bridge-wide batch requests.

data_description.source: * Quick selection uses the button’s short-press lights: individual lights, groups and lists. For scenes and scripts, choose Custom lights.

button_1.name: Button 1
button_1.description: Short press has no recognition delay unless double/triple press is enabled. Multi-press: up to 400 ms from release to the next press. REST can shorten waiting; SSE preserves the press count. If REST is unavailable, the conservative 1.4 s wait remains. Long press runs once.
